description: The Gujarat government has proposed a ₹20 crore artificial intelligence (AI) training initiative to equip five lakh higher education students with AI skills, including generative AI applications and discipline-specific tools.The proposed Gujarat AI for Every Student Mission 2026–27 aims to introduce AI literacy across higher education institutions and prepare students for emerging employment opportunities. According to the draft policy prepared by the state’s Higher Education Department, the programme is awaiting administrative and financial approvals.Three-Tier AI Training Programme For StudentsThe proposed mission will follow a three-tier training framework, covering basic AI literacy, specialised applications and advanced employability skills.Under the first tier, AI Foundation for Every Student, five lakh students will receive eight hours of basic training covering AI applications, prompt writing and productivity tools.The second tier, AI for Domain Applications, will provide 25 hours of specialised training to one lakh students across disciplines such as engineering, commerce, humanities, science, agriculture, healthcare, education and law.The third tier, Advanced AI Skills and Employability, will target 20,000 students through 50 hours of project-based learning. The training will include practical exercises, industry case studies, capstone projects and assessments.Gujarat Plans To Train 5,000 Faculty MembersAlongside student training, the state government has proposed preparing 5,000 faculty members as AI Master Trainers within 12 months to support the mission's implementation.The courses will be offered in English and Gujarati, with training covering responsible AI use, data protection and verification of AI-generated information.The proposed implementation framework includes a State Mission Unit, university-level nodal officers and college coordinators. A digital dashboard will also be developed to monitor student enrolment, participation and certification.Mission Awaits Government ApprovalThe proposed initiative seeks to expand AI literacy across Gujarat's higher education institutions while strengthening students' readiness for a technology-driven job market.However, the Gujarat AI for Every Student Mission 2026–27 is currently at the draft policy stage. Its rollout will depend on the required administrative and financial clearances from the state government.
